title: 견적서관리 수량 수정·음수재고 확정 보정 계약

actions.name: QUANTITY_EDIT
actions.shipmentDate: update ShipmentQuantity/EstQuantity/Amount/Vat for the selected SdateKey
actions.stockCalc: unfixed rows do not invoke native calculation; fixed rows apply the signed Product.Stock delta, append nonmanual shipment StockHistory, run product-scoped usp_StockCalculation, and reject current/future negative ProductStock in the same transaction

actions.name: QUANTITY_ZERO_PURGE
actions.fixCycle: none; the direct fixed-status-preserving transaction purges only the zeroed ShipmentDetail/ShipmentDate/ShipmentFarm scope

crossYearFixture.description: 같은 OrderWeek가 2025·2026에 있어도 견적 수량·확정·재고조정은 선택된 ShipmentMaster.OrderYear 행만 대상으로 한다. 음수재고 보정은 화면에 표시된 품목별 정확한 부족수량만 기록한다.

sideEffects.stockIncreasePreflight: 수량 저장과 동일하게 잠근 Product.Stock 현재고에서 양수 증가분만 차감해 음수 여부를 판정한다. Product.Stock에는 기존 확정 출고가 이미 반영되어 있으므로 기존 ViewShipment 합계를 다시 빼지 않는다.
sideEffects.futureStockShortageDisplay: usp_StockCalculation과 같은 StockMaster.OrderYearWeek >= 시작 OrderYearWeek 범위에서 첫 음수 ProductStock을 OrderYearWeek+StockKey 오름차순으로 선택하고 서버 잠금 품종·품목명·ProdKey·음수 차수·재고값을 오류와 stockValidation에 반환한다.
sideEffects.fixedShipment: preserve isFix; update the selected physical row and its signed stock delta atomically without week-wide unfix/refix
sideEffects.reconfirmFailure: not applicable to existing quantity edits because no unfix/refix is performed; additional-product creation keeps its separate scoped fix-cycle contract
sideEffects.negativeStockRecovery: explicit confirm only -> StockHistory 재고조정(+exact shortage) -> usp_StockCalculation -> usp_ShipmentFix
sideEffects.stockMutation: for fixed physical rows only, Product.Stock is adjusted by the signed quantity delta inside the locked transaction and then product-scoped usp_StockCalculation rebuilds snapshots; unfixed and Estimate-only rows do not change Product.Stock
sideEffects.stockShortageDisplay: 재고 부족 오류는 잠긴 Product 행의 CountryFlower + ProdName + ProdKey를 함께 표시하고 클라이언트 제공 이름은 사용하지 않는다.
sideEffects.zeroQuantity: setting the last/only date row to 0 purges ShipmentDetail+ShipmentDate+ShipmentFarm, hides the row from estimate (EstQuantity>0), and preserves OrderDetail
